note: WP-16: character family looks. A family is a look (line: stroke weight factor, eye: eye size factor, head: head size factor, ink: line colour) and palettes its members' clothes and hair are drawn from, applied on top of cast.generate (puppet/generator.py). cast.family makes and registers a family's members; each member's own spec wins over the family's defaults.

house.about: the house style: every generated character so far

bold-round.about: a younger look: heavy navy line, bigger heads and eyes

fine.about: an older-reader look: thin warm-grey line, smaller eyes
